## 2024-05-18 - SVG XSS via dangerouslySetInnerHTML in Plan Generators
**Vulnerability:** Untrusted SVG raw string inputs (`output.svg` and `svgOutput`) were passed to `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` and `document.write()` without sanitization in `DeedPlanGenerator.tsx` and `MutationPlanGenerator.tsx`. This exposes the application to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) if malicious payloads were inserted into the drawing generation logic.
**Learning:** React's `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` expects pre-sanitized HTML. Even auto-generated SVGs can contain embedded `<script>` or `onload=` handlers if their inputs (like user-supplied text nodes or foreign objects) aren't constrained. DOMPurify must be carefully configured to allow safe SVG tags while stripping XSS vectors.
**Prevention:** Always wrap dynamically generated SVG or HTML strings in a tested sanitization function (like `sanitizeHtml` from `src/lib/security/sanitize.ts`) before injecting them into the DOM, even if they originated from internal computational libraries.
